subject: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - follow-up from discovery call

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap and next steps on the GDPR items we discussed so your legal/security team can iterate: 

Summary from our call:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference on customer data (PII possible).
- You asked about our SOC 2 status, an executed DPA, and which EU SCC module applies.

Attachments I’m sharing: Redwood_DPA_template_v1.pdf and SCC_mapping_guide.xlsx (high level mapping of SCC modules to common customer relationships).

Key asks / next steps for Acme:
1) Confirm whether Acme will be the data controller for the workload (this determines SCC module selection).
2) If you have redlines to a DPA, please send them back (I attached our template).
3) We can share our SOC 2 Type II report via secure link/portal once we have an NDA or mutual access arrangement — please confirm who on your side should receive it.
4) If helpful, start the vendor security questionnaire at: https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-questionnaire/ACME-2026 — that collects the baseline evidence our security team needs and speeds review.

Proposed Redwood position (to help speed alignment):
- Redwood will act as a Processor (we process customer data on behalf of Acme).
- For GDPR transfers, the appropriate SCC module for a controller -> processor relationship is Module 2 (controller -> processor). If Acme confirms controller role, we’ll propose Module 2 in the SCC addendum.

I’ve looped in Rishi (Security) and Neha (Legal ops) — they can jump on a short call to walk through any redlines and next-steps if you prefer.

Would appreciate a short reply with: (a) controller vs processor confirmation, (b) SOC 2 request contact, and (c) whether you’ll send initial DPA comments.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v1.pdf, SCC_mapping_guide.xlsx
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - follow-up from discovery call

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the templates. A few quick notes from Acme legal/security after a first pass: 

1) Controller/Processor: Acme will be the Controller for customer data in this use case.
2) SCC Module: We agree that controller -> processor flow points to Module 2. We’d like the SCC module to be included as an addendum to the DPA.
3) DPA redlines: We have initial comments — I attached Acme_DPA_comments.docx with a couple of requested edits around subprocessor notification and data retention limits.
4) SOC 2: Please confirm your SOC 2 status (Type II?). We will need the most recent report or a summary and a secure way to access the full report. Our security team listed in CC (security@acme.com) will handle that intake.

If possible, please provide a marked-up DPA with your acceptance/positions and share the SOC 2 via the secure channel. If Redwood prefers DocuSign for signature we can support that.

Quoted for context — your original: 
> Proposed Redwood position (to help speed alignment):
> - Redwood will act as a Processor (we process customer data on behalf of Acme).
> - For GDPR transfers, the appropriate SCC module for a controller -> processor relationship is Module 2 (controller -> processor).

John Doe
Security Program Manager | Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0133

Attachment: Acme_DPA_comments.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotla <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - follow-up from discovery call

John —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. Short answers and proposed next steps below.

Answers:
- Controller/Processor: Confirmed — Redwood will be the Processor. Acme is the Controller.
- SCC Module: We agree to include Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) as the SCC addendum. I’ll have Legal produce a version with Module 2 referenced explicitly.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (period ending Dec 31, 2025). I’ve shared a SOC 2 summary internally; we can provide the full report via our secure portal. Vivek (security) — can you confirm preferred transfer mechanism for Acme (email access vs secure share)? We currently use time-limited links and require an NDA or secure intake form prior to full report access. Summary link: https://drive.redwood.com/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf

On the DPA redlines you sent: Neha (legal ops) and I will review Acme_DPA_comments.docx and produce a marked-up DPA with positions. If there are material changes we’ll flag them, otherwise we’ll push a redline back for comment. We can also prepare the DPA for DocuSign when both sides are agreed.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) Today: Redwood legal to review Acme_DPA_comments.docx and circulate a redline (target: EOD PDT).
2) Tomorrow: Security teams to confirm SOC 2 access method.
3) Early next week: 30-minute call with Acme security + Redwood security (Rishi & Vivek) to resolve any open control questions and finalize SCC wording.

If that works I’ll send a quick meeting invite for Tuesday or Wednesday next week.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
